text:
Sam S: Quick question — Acme POC needs to drop SOC/ISO evidence + a pen-test report. They want presigned upload links but are worried about expiry and KMS separation. Also asking whether those uploads will count toward the staging burst/billing. Need a concise answer to share with the customer by EOD.

Maya R: We can generate presigned S3 PUT links from the evidence bucket. Default expiry is 1h but we can set to any TTL up to 7d. For hosted customers we use our managed SSE-KMS key (no customer CMK). For dedicated/private we can support customer-managed keys. cc Diego for security: @Diego L

Diego L: Correct — hosted = our managed CMK only. If they require a separate CMK, that triggers Private/Dedicated. For presigned links with SSE-KMS the server-side key is our key; client cannot choose a CMK. Recommend shorter expiry for sensitive uploads (15–30m). Also recommend ephemeral creds + scan window for pen-test uploads.

Sam S: Thanks. Can we also confirm whether presigned uploads are treated differently for billing? Sales asked if these are considered "staging burst" traffic.

Maya R: Presigned vs direct upload doesn't change billing — it's still data ingress/storage/PUT requests. For POCs we include the first 50GB of transfer/storage in the staging bundle. Anything beyond is regular usage. I'll confirm exact thresholds and send numbers.

Diego L: From security side — suggested defaults for this POC: presigned expiry 30m, require header enforcement for SSE (aws:kms), and bucket policy to restrict uploads to a single folder per customer (e.g., evidence/acme-poc/). Also require pen-test uploads to include a metadata tag scan=pen-test so we can auto-scan.

audit-bot: Attached: SOC2-excerpt.pdf (internal link) and pen-test-attestation-template.docx. Use legal template for customer signature.

Ava K: Legal here — pen-test attestation needs scoped dates, signer name, and a brief scope paragraph. We retain evidence in the bucket for 30 days by default; if customer wants longer we need a change order. Also happy to provide a sanitized network diagram (redacted) rather than full diagram.

Sam S: Action items: 1) Maya confirm free-staging threshold (50GB noted) and set presigned default to 30m for Acme; 2) Diego share attestation + recommended scan window (ephemeral creds + 9–11am PST suggested); 3) Ava produce redacted diagram + legal redline if customer asks for more. I'll consolidate and reply to customer after we confirm. @Maya R @Diego L @Ava K

Maya R: On it. Confirmed staging free tier: first 50GB inbound/storage covered for trial. Presigned command i'm going to use for them:

```
# generate 30m presigned PUT for evidence file
aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/evidence/acme-poc/scan-report.pdf --region us-west-2 --expires-in 1800 \
  --request-payer requester
```

Note: we enforce SSE-KMS on the bucket; clients must include header: x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms (they cannot supply a different CMK on hosted).

Diego L: I'll DM the attestation doc and include the recommended scan folder pattern: evidence/acme-poc/pen-test/YYYYMMDD. Recommend scan window 09:00–11:00 PST and ephemeral creds rotated hourly for upload.

Ava K: I'll prepare the redacted network diagram and a short legal blurb re: retention and scope. If customer requests CMK ownership we need to scope Private/Dedicated pricing — that'll be a separate commercial ask.

Sam S: Perfect. I'll send a single note to the customer: presigned links (30m), first 50GB covered, hosted uses Redwood-managed KMS, pen-test attestation template + suggested scan window, redacted diagram available, escalation path for CMK/Private. Back to me with any edits by 4:30pm and I’ll reply. :thumbsup:

Maya R: Editing now.

Diego L: +1 on the plan.

Ava K: +1.

Sam S: Thanks all — closing thread after customer reply.
